What it would do differently

The leads the player wrote, each with where it happened and what would settle it. An ask is a link into the replay above.

  1. The Magic Mapping scroll's window, measured on this seed: 44 rows × 80 columns, 16% of the level, and no down staircase in it.

    Read at the arrival point of depth 1 (the up staircase), the M map afterwards (ask 22) showed 280 of 1716 box tiles with terrain and no >; the M view at ask 92, after my own exploration, showed the > at box (28, 2) — 24 boxes away from the arrival point, just outside the mapped area. That is the third run to read a Magic Mapping scroll and find no staircase in it (the others: minimaxflash-1.4, sonnet-2). If it is a coin flip, then 65 gold is 4 kills of oil and the scroll is not worth buying at all.

    What would settle it: the same experiment on four or five seeds, counting the > in the M view after reading.

    ask 22, 92 · turn 608-6,814

  2. A depth-1 staircase costs about 100 decisions of exploration.

    Measured here: 73 decisions between the scroll and the > appearing on the M map, 99 in all from arriving on depth 1 to descending. The M map's coverage percentage is the instrument that says whether the hunt is going anywhere: 16% after the scroll, 26% when the staircase appeared.

    What would settle it: whether a second Magic Mapping scroll, read at the far side of the level after walking there, finds a staircase where the first did not.

  3. The beam chain is fast and it is what killed me.

    Measured: 45-60 keys in one decision, and about 45 new tiles remembered per decision while it worked through the dark (16% → 26% of a level in 70 decisions). It also walks into whatever is in the dark. The chain of ask 140 killed about thirty-five silver mice in one decision — that is +35 experience and three character levels — and then died.

    What would settle it: a chain planner that stops at the first visible monster instead of only avoiding the monsters it can see, and the same coverage rate.

    ask 140 · turn 10,750

  4. Depth 2 is where the experience is.

    A giant black ant (11 HP, AC 24, 1d2) pays 8 experience at CL2 and 16 at CL1, against 5 for a small kobold at CL1 on depth 1.

    What would settle it: a run that buys 20 flasks of oil, goes straight to depth 2, and counts the kills per character level.

  5. Grey moulds are 8 damage a turn, not 4, and they sit at the end of corridors.

    Two of them took 15 hit points off me at once, and I had no heal. it is a fact in monster.txt (two blow:SPORE:HURT:1d4 lines) that the manual's table does not show.

    What would settle it: nothing here;

  6. The throw prompt never finished.

    v a ' printed "The apprentice is targeted" and then nothing I sent (g, Enter, a direction key, Escape) took the shot; I cancelled it.

    What would settle it: one run in which the keys that do fire a thrown flask are found and written down — the throw is the only ranged attack a Warrior has and I could not use it.

What it kept

- SEED CHOSEN: 271 (not in records/OVERVIEW.md; used seeds there are 103,23,41,313,1,7,11). Files I actually opened before my first keypress: manuals/INSTRUCTIONS.md (full), agents/minimax/COMMON.md (full), agents/minimax/WARRIOR.md (full, my own family page for this class - I did NOT have to borrow another family's page). I wrote no tools of my own this run; I plan to use the shared tools/screen/* ones. (ask 1)
- Alchemist stock on this seed/day: 40 Cure Light Wounds 20g, Neutralize Poison 75, Berserk Strength 80, Resist Cold 30x6, 40 Phase Door 15, 3 Magic Mapping 65, Remove Curse 100, Remove Hunger 10x8, Word of Recall 125x40, Blessing 15x17, Holy Chant 40x19. Bought 1 Magic Mapping (65g) - source check: effect_handler_MAP_AREA calls square_memorize() on every non-wall square AND on its 8 neighbours, so MM writes into cave->memory, not just a display. (ask 14)
- Plan: depth 1 - press M FIRST (the prior Warrior minimaxflash-3 spent 66 asks on depth 1 without pressing M and the staircase had been on its own panel the whole time), read the Magic Mapping scroll, then explore. (ask 15)
- MM read on depth 1 at CL1. expect 5 experience for the first use (kind level 5, formula (5+CL/2)/CL = 5 at CL1). (ask 21)
- Depth 1: Magic Mapping revealed 16% of the level and NO down staircase (M view, box 78x22) - so MM does not always show one. lxg walked only 1 tile and stopped at an awake white worm mass; I was in a dead-end pocket (walls E and W, up staircase S, worm mass N, door N beyond it), so the worm mass had to die. (ask 24)
- Correcting my own note: the Magic Mapping scroll was BOUGHT, so it was already identified and its first use paid NO experience (NXT stayed 12). The white worm mass kill paid 2 (NXT 12 -> 10). Also: the white worm mass died in one turn of melee with the dagger and did NOT multiply (25% chance, I was lucky), and it never touched me. (ask 26)
- I wrote two tools of my own for this run, both copied from my own family's earlier runs and stated here as the prompt requires: runs/mmx-war-1/tools/beam.py (from minimaxflash-1.5/g.py, with the panel slice corrected from [14:80] to [13:79] so the known/unknown boundary is right) and runs/mmx-war-1/tools/open.py (from minimaxflash-3/tools/open.py, unchanged). (ask 27)
- The two C glyphs are CANINE base monsters (monster_base.txt: base 'canine' has glyph C) - at depth 1 that is the wild dog: 3 hp, AC 3, speed 110, 1d1 damage, 1 experience, friends 2d7 (a pack). The '(' glyph on the floor is armour (Robe, Soft Leather, Studded Leather, Hard Leather, Leather Scale Mail, Cloak, Fur Cloak, Elven Cloak, Ethereal Cloak). (ask 31)
- MEASURED: a -more- at the end of the previous screen swallowed my 'g' key, so the pickup never happened and the chain still ran. Always start the string with a space when the last screen ended in -more-. The wild dog bit me for 2 (19 -> 17 HP); the dogs are awake now. (ask 33)
- BUG FOUND AND FIXED in my own copy of the beam tool: the screen dump strips trailing whitespace, so a map row that is entirely blank comes back as a short line; the original tool then read every tile on that row as a WALL, which is why it reported 0 unknown squares. Fixed with .ljust(66). This is the same reason the shared screen.py ljusts its rows. Worth telling my family: any tool that slices the panel out of a raw dump must pad it. (ask 34)
- DEPTH 2 REACHED at ask 118 (was 106 asks of exploring depth 1: Magic Mapping revealed 16%, my sweeps added to 26%, and the down staircase finally appeared on the M map at box (28,2)). The staircase was found after ~106 asks, not the ~60 I had hoped. Dagger 1d4+3, to-hit 84, 2.77 blows, CL2 with 32 max HP, 21 flasks of oil, 7 gold, a Grey Potion (unknown kind, pack letter d), 5 Orange Speckled Potions, a Scroll of Word of Recall and an unknown scroll (pack letter g; 6.9% chance it is a Deep Descent, which would now drop me to depth 7 - too deep to survive, so I will not read it). (ask 119)

note: BUG FOUND AND FIXED in my own copy of the beam tool: the screen dump strips trailing whitespace, so a map row that is entirely blank comes back as a short line; the original tool then read every tile on that row as a WALL, which is why it reported 0 unknown squares. Fixed with .ljust(66). This is the same reason the shared screen.py ljusts its rows. Worth telling my family: any tool that slices the panel out of a raw dump must pad it. (ask 34)
